comment: Named search areas of the urban disaster zone, metres relative to the UAV base (takeoff point): north = world y, east = world x. The flight altitude is fixed at 6 m: the horizontal slice the lidar maps. The areas are EXTERIOR: rubble field, alley, street, courtyard floor. Interiors of standing structures are out of scope: the 2D lidar slice cannot see overhead or slabs just below its plane, and flights that entered a collapsed building through a facade opening ended in impacts (results/disaster_gazebo/live/*onebody, *demo1; simulation/mujoco/results/dev/mission_B_interior). The *_full places keep the old rectangles that include interiors; they are kept for stress tests and are NOT flight-safe.

collapsed_block.description: the rubble field and the alley east of the collapsed multi-storey apartment block (exterior only)

commercial_block.description: the plaza and fallen facade south-west of the commercial building (exterior only)

courtyard.description: the floor of the U-shaped courtyard (exterior only)

disaster_zone.description: the exterior of the disaster zone: the rubble field and alley east of the collapsed block, the blocked street and the plaza west of the commercial building (exterior only)

collapsed_block_full.description: the collapsed apartment block INCLUDING the standing west half and the alley (not flight-safe: interior slabs)

disaster_zone_full.description: the whole zone rectangle INCLUDING building interiors (not flight-safe)
